official_definition: Absolute Unleash: 4 [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents) Refresh three Spirits you control. Then, when advented onto an "Absolute" family Spirit, if it's your Attack Step, you can put four cores from your "Grandwalker Zeus-Lolo" to your Spirits. When you've done so, target one card on the opposing Hand/Removed Zone. Discard all other cards.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Absolute Unleash] or [Absolute Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Absolute Unleash]", "give [Absolute Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
